false_claims_or_bugs: Says clicking trash 'usually does nothing visible', but splice mutates state in place, so the row disappears on the next unrelated re-render (overstated, not a seeded defect).
A.notes: Every seeded defect is named with the right location and consequence, e.g. 'handleExport() is called during render, not passed as a handler' and 'sorted.length && (' rendering 0 is flagged in item 4. Bonus items (context value, div/img a11y, unlabelled search, unencoded query) are also covered.

false_claims_or_bugs: Item 17 says column reordering can reuse DOM nodes, but columns is never reordered (overstated).
Fix for item 3 calls an undefined helper fetchOrders (sketch only, minor).
B.notes: All 16 seeded defects are identified with evidence, e.g. 'Two setSelected(selected + 1) calls read the same stale selected' and 'removeOrder splices orders ... setOrders(orders) passes the same reference'. Bonus items are covered as well, with fixes that include concrete code.

r1-review-orderlist.reason: Both reviews identify all 16 seeded defects with accurate consequences and no material false claims; the differences are presentation and minor overstatements.

false_claims_or_bugs: Item sort comparator a.name.localeCompare(b.name) throws if a product has no name (minor, not guarded unlike the other submission).
Key falls back to index when p.id is absent; this is stated as an assumption in notes, so it is disclosed rather than a false claim.
A.notes: The effect uses 'const controller = new AbortController()' with 'return () => controller.abort()' and deps '[query, category]', and the error path shows 'Could not load products.' with role alert. Results are copied before sorting ('[...results].sort') and the list is guarded with 'sortedResults.length > 0'; the button inside li makes items keyboard operable.

false_claims_or_bugs: Item 12 not met: result rows keep onClick on the li ('<li key={p.id ?? i} onClick={() => onSelect(p)}>'), so they are not keyboard operable.
Failed requests clear results and stop loading but show no error message, although notes present it as handled; there is no error state in the code.
Key fallback to index when p.id is absent, disclosed in notes.
B.notes: The race is handled with AbortController and the deps are '[query, category]', but the catch branch only does 'setResults([]); setLoading(false);' with no user-facing error. The result items remain plain li elements with onClick, so keyboard users cannot select a product.

r2-fix-productsearch.reason: A meets all 13 items including error display and keyboard-operable results; B misses the error state and keyboard operability, while both fix the race, encoding, deps, and sort mutation.

false_claims_or_bugs: Enter is not guarded during IME composition (handleKeyDown has no isComposing check), so committing a Japanese or Chinese candidate with Enter adds a chip prematurely (minor).
After a successful send the pending list is replaced by 'Loading pending invites...' during the reload, a UX flicker rather than a correctness bug.
A.notes: Team change is handled by remounting with 'return <InviteMembersForTeam key={teamId} teamId={teamId} />', so no effect syncs state. Enter with an empty draft is left to submit ('Enter with an empty draft is left alone so it submits the form'), and the invalid/duplicate checks are case-insensitive via parseCandidates with knownEmails.

false_claims_or_bugs: Enter with an empty draft is always preventDefault-ed ('if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === ",") { event.preventDefault(); applyAdd(draft); }'), so pressing Enter cannot submit the form and item 12 is not met.

Team change is reset through an effect ('useEffect(() => { setInvites([]); setChips([]); ... }, [teamId])'), which is the state-sync-by-effect pattern the key penalises, and the first render after a team change still shows the old invites until the effect runs.
Notes claim the teamId reset is complete, but the stale first render contradicts that.
B.notes: Load and send use AbortController or teamRef guards, and error, loading and empty states exist with 'Try again'. However the reset-by-effect on teamId and the non-submitting Enter key ('event.preventDefault(); applyAdd(draft);' with no submit path) fail items 9 and 12.

r3-build-invite.reason: A meets all 13 items with a key-based reset and Enter submitting an empty form; B relies on a sync effect for team reset and blocks Enter-to-submit, missing items 9 and 12.
